queries_run: Navitas Semiconductor China tariff OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素：公司明列受美國出口管制與制裁法規約束，可能限制對中國終端客戶的產品出口；美中關稅或貿易戰可能對財務與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: These actions could lead to additional restrictions on the export of products that include or enable certain technologies, including products we provide to China-based end customers. The institution of trade tariffs both globally and between the U.S. and China specifically could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出美國法規已將化合物半導體與寬能隙半導體（GaN、SiC）歸類為「對國家安全關鍵」，涉及 CFIUS 審查與出口許可風險。
findings.excerpt: U.S. regulatory initiatives over the past several years have classified certain semiconductor technologies as “critical to national security,” including compound semiconductors and wide bandgap semiconductors. Both GaN and SiC are compound semiconductors and wide bandgap semiconductors.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出出口限制可能促使終端客戶自研替代方案或轉向不受限制的競爭對手。
findings.excerpt: may also encourage end customers to develop their own solutions to replace 26 TABLE OF CONTENTS our products, or seek to obtain a greater supply of similar or substitute products from competitors that are not subject to these restrictions

findings.claim: 2025 Q1 10-Q：中國報復性關稅或非關稅壁壘可能在未來 12–18 個月侵蝕 SiC 產品定價競爭力，因目前依賴單一美國來源。

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年 Section 232 對 NVTS 的具體官方報導或實體清單事件；Seeking Alpha 用戶貼文稱部分豁免，屬非官方，未採用。2025 年 Q1 10-Q 提及中國報復性關稅可能侵蝕 SiC 定價（單一美國來源），見 clues。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
